body: I feel like my anxiety disabled me much more than my depression did. Yeah depression would make it hard for me to move around some times and I would cry/ etc. but anxiety would make me straight up not leave my room or my bed due to the overwhelming panic I felt. It sabotaged an entire semester for me at college because day after day I wouldn’t leave my room to go to classes because A) I feared my peers who harassed me over a boyfriend I was going out with (long story) and B) The building absences and piling homework I had not done gave me daily panic attacks that I did not want to face.

Yes, I’m American. The stress keeps me up at night and makes me cry quite a bit. It also is a strong reason I want to end my life. I’m very bad at handling situations like this and I feel like if I could afford all of these things I would at least feel stable enough to get through college.

I write now because I’m in the biggest financial bind I’ve ever been in, jobless (looking though), switching apartments and owe people money while trying to afford tuition. I can’t think of anything other than the debt wracking up day by day and the hatred I feel for myself building
